conviction_note: The 9M statement on 2026-11-05 lands nine days after an ad-hoc guidance cut (sales EUR405-425m from 425-485m, EBIT margin 5-7% from 8-10%) that already told the market Q3 order intake stayed high and the order book hit a record. So the guide is unlikely to move, the Q3 P&L sits inside a freshly reset bar, and the only real unknowns are the Q3 order intake figure, working capital and any 2027 delivery visibility. That leaves a small positive lean (p_up 53) on a move of about 5.5% either way; the findings sum to +0.6 against +0.33 scaled, the same sign and small enough that the gap is not meaningful.

findings.finding: The order line, the one that drove the name's worst past print (Oct 2025, Q3 orders EUR70m, stock -21%), has been pre-signalled positive: SUSS said on 2026-10-27 that Q3 order intake 'remained at a high level' and the order book reached a new record above H1's EUR473.7m, and Berenberg expected higher Q3 orders. The exact figure, the book-to-bill and any update to the 2027-scheduled backlog are still unpublished.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 (orders EUR70m, book-to-bill ~0.6, margin cut at the same time): -21%. Q2 2026 (record orders EUR260.7m incl. a EUR115m order, guide confirmed): the stock 'barely reacted' on the day (stock3, 2026-08-06). So good order news has not been paid on this name recently; a bad order number was.
findings.original_quote: Order intake remained at a high level in the third quarter, and the order book reached a new record level. | Berenberg (kapitalmarktexperten.de, 2026-10-18): "Berenberg hält an der Kaufempfehlung fest und rechnet im dritten Quartal mit mehr Bestellungen bei unveränderten Auslieferungen." (Berenberg keeps its Buy and expects more orders in Q3 with deliveries unchanged.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the qualitative statement was in the Oct 27 release and the cut closed only -4% after an intraday -13%. The number is not public. If the market believed in a strong order print, the stock would have recovered toward the pre-cut 52-55 range and the short register would be shrinking, not edging up (1.15->1.22%). It still sits at 51 after a -23% 20-day run-up.
findings.independence: Berenberg Q3 preview via dpa-AFX: https://www.kapitalmarktexperten.de/suess-microtec-aktie-auftraege-statt-lieferungen/ (2026-10-18). Peer Besi Q3 orders +17% q/q: https://www.allinvestview.com/earnings/BESI.AS/q3-2026/ (2026-10-24). The company statement and the Berenberg note are separate sources.

findings.finding: The guidance event was taken out of the print by a MAR ad-hoc nine days earlier ('Prognoseanpassung'), and the sell-side reset its targets the next day while staying Buy. The statement therefore very probably carries a reiterated guide, not a fresh cut, and the name enters with that bar lowered.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior guide cuts came WITH the results (Jul 2025 ~-20%, Oct 2025 -21% to -27% on the estimated dates). This time the cut came by ad-hoc: -13% intraday, -4.0% at the close on 2026-10-27, +5.3% the next day.
findings.original_quote: Börsen-Zeitung, 2026-10-27: "Der Vorstand korrigierte deshalb die Umsatz- und Gewinnprognosen nach unten: Der Umsatz werde 2026 auf 405 bis 425 (2025: 503) Mill. Euro zurückgehen" (The board therefore cut its sales and profit forecasts: 2026 sales are to fall to EUR405-425m).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced; the residual is the relief of a print without a second cut. That is worth little, because the guide sits inside what the company already said.
findings.independence: Analyst target reset (Jefferies, Berenberg, DB, ODDO, all still Buy): https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/suss-microtec-aktie-prognosesenkung-belastet-analysten-kurzen-kursziele (2026-10-28). It rests on the same ad-hoc, so it is merged here.

findings.finding: The reset guide implies a weak H2 P&L, and component shortages point to a working-capital build. On H1's EUR202.8m sales and ~EUR14.2m EBIT (7.0%), the guide leaves H2 sales of EUR202-222m and H2 EBIT of roughly EUR6-16m including ~EUR4.5m of one-offs, so a low reported Q3 margin is likely. Deliveries delayed by 'constrained supply ... for certain components' point to inventory build, a risk to the H1 FCF of +EUR16.4m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 EBIT margin 4.3% was followed by recovery (+9.4% around the estimated Apr-30 date). The margin trend drove the Oct-2025 sell-off ('Suss erschreckt Anleger mit enttäuschendem Margentrend').
findings.why_not_priced: The P&L arithmetic is inside the guide and therefore priced, so it is sized toward 0. The cash-flow leg is not in the guide and nothing public quantifies it. That residual is the only reason this finding is not 0.
findings.independence: The supply-constraint statement is in the 2026-10-27 ad-hoc: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/suss-microtec-se-suss-resolves-production-relocation-and-adjusts-guidance-for-fiscal-year-2026/547ae9e8-160e-4baa-a81e-6a7656368a8d_en

findings.finding: Peer read from the closest listed advanced-packaging equipment peer: Besi's Q3 2026 orders rose 17% q/q to EUR342.6m (+96% y/y), and Besi expects order momentum to continue in Q4. Besi's stock still fell 10.7% on HBM stack-height timing, so demand for this kind of equipment is confirmed and the sector has been selling good order prints.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SUSS fell 7.7% on 2026-10-22, around Besi's print, and 3.6% on 2026-10-17 in a global semiconductor sell-off with no company trigger (kapitalmarktexperten 2026-10-18). The name trades with the sector.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, since SUSS moved with Besi's reaction. It is a proxy: Besi is hybrid and die bonding, while SUSS is coating, temporary bonding and aligners. Kept small.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, the same way as the baseline's priced_lean (+1.74, mostly the -23% 20-day run-up), so they add little against the free control; the slight short build (+0.07pp) points marginally the other way.
language_note: The German press (Börsen-Zeitung, goldesel, trading-treff) carried the 2026-10-27 intraday reaction (-13%, low since March), the closing context and the Jefferies quote; the English searches returned mostly 2025 stories and no 2026 coverage of the cut at all.
Only a German source (kapitalmarktexperten via dpa-AFX, 2026-10-18) carried Berenberg's Q3 preview, expecting higher orders and flat deliveries.
Only a German source (goldesel, 2026-10-28) carried the four broker target resets; I found no English equivalent.
The primary documents (ad-hoc, H1 release, IR calendar) are bilingual on EQS and suss.com; the English versions carry the same numbers.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the order-line finding was cut from +1.0 to +0.6, because the company already said 'high level / record book'; only the exact figure is new.

'The move is in the guide', with the guide reset by ad-hoc nine days earlier: finding 2 went from +0.3 to +0.2 and p_up from 55 to 53, inside the 45-55 band for a pre-released period with an unchanged guide. abs_move_pct stays 5.5: the measured base is ~3% for pre-released periods, but this name has 61% realised vol and an estimated reaction median of 7.5% that is a lower bound, and the understatement lesson argues against cutting it.

'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the component-shortage working-capital risk was folded into finding 3, which stays at -0.3; I did not file a separate finding because no sourced number backs it.
'A narrow proxy loses' / 'verified fact is not a predicted reaction': the Besi peer read went from +0.2 to +0.1, because Besi itself was sold on strong orders.
